name: Koshiba Azami
source:
Azami is a [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Java_Sparrow]Java Sparrow[/URL] that Hiyoko meets after getting lost on a jog. She possesses excellent fighting skills and an extreme amount of cool, plus a whole lot of caution when it comes to travelling on the roads on her trusty pink scooter. Her catchphrase is "Carve it into your soul!" She is part of a sidestory that is available during summer.

NOTE: Azami is a full version-only character.

[Taken from her [URL=http://hatoful.wikia.com/wiki/Azami_Koshiba]Hatoful Boyfriend Wikia[/URL] entry.]
